title: CanonicalDailyBar
description: Vendor-neutral daily OHLCV bar. Schema version 1.0.0.

event_date.description: Event time: the trading session the bar belongs to.

observation_time.description: Observation time: when Baculus received this version from the vendor.

source_artifact_id.description: SHA-256 of the raw vendor artifact this bar was derived from.

decimalPrice.description: Fixed-precision decimal price (Decimal(18,8)); serialized as a normalized decimal string, never binary float. See ADR-0008.
